DetectorTypeSource changed from assumed to original (2026-10-26, header only, curves unchanged): the GOES-R Calibration Working Group (Efremova, Pearlman, Padula & Wu 2016, Proc. The SRF thus integrates directly over spectral radiance: energy in SED_Tools' convention.

E, effective 2022-07-22, https://www.star.nesdis.noaa.gov/jpss/documents/ATBD/D0001-M01-S01-003_JPSS_ATBD_VIIRS-SDR_E.pdf, §2.3 General Radiometric Equations, Eq. 9) states 'The Relative Spectral Response (RSR) is defined as the normalized product of the quantum efficiency, wavelength, and optical transmittance.
